releaseNotes:
🚀 User Reviews, Instagram Reels & Quoted Reply Context (v1.0.8) by Dhiraj:
• ⭐ User Review & Feedback Hub: Users can rate (1-5 stars) and submit feedback directly inside the app; instant live delivery to Developer Dashboard and ntfy.sh live feed!
• 🎬 Instagram Reels Extraction & Deep Link: Reels are no longer misidentified as generic photos. Automatically captures Reel URL & caption with an interactive 'Watch ➔' card that opens directly in Instagram!
• ↩️ Quoted Reply Context: When someone replies to a specific message in WhatsApp/Telegram/Instagram, MsgVault captures the original quoted message and displays it in a clean WhatsApp-style quote bubble inside the chat.
• 🛡️ Safe Room Migration (v4->v5): Existing chat histories, voice notes, and media remain 100% intact without any data loss.
